posts.title: Chronicles of Ankhara: Quest for the Godkiller Is Out Now
posts.excerpt: The journey begins. Chronicles of Ankhara: Quest for the Godkiller is now available on Amazon Kindle and Kindle Unlimited.
posts.body:
The journey into Ankhara begins.

Chronicles of Ankhara: Quest for the Godkiller is officially available on Amazon Kindle and Kindle Unlimited.

Five hundred years ago, the Gods abandoned Ankhara. Now something they left behind is beginning to awaken.

Nisha has escaped from a land that should not exist. Behind her lies Shadow—a forgotten power gathering monsters, raising the dead, and preparing for a war the Five Kingdoms do not yet know is coming.

Her only hope may be Tuth, a solitary hunter from the Wilds who wants nothing to do with kingdoms, gods, or their wars.

Together, they must cross a divided world of elemental magic, ancient faiths, and rival kingdoms in search of the legendary Godkiller.

But some legends were never meant to be found.

about.heading: About AltWorld Comics
about.body:
AltWorld Comics is an independent publishing label founded by storyteller Tutku Tuzlu.

The label publishes original fiction, original comics, and remastered public-domain classics. Its projects range from epic fantasy and technological thrillers to dark fairy tales and forgotten Golden Age heroes.

AltWorld Comics was built around a simple idea: stories deserve a chance to be told. Modern creative tools make it possible to develop worlds, restore old material, experiment with visual storytelling, and publish independently without the infrastructure of a traditional studio.

The goal is not simple nostalgia and it is not limited to one format. Books and comics sit side by side under the AltWorld Comics name, each project given room to develop its own identity.

Old tales. New adventures. Different worlds.
